name: WritingPreferenceBench
description: WritingPreferenceBench is a dataset of 1,800 human-annotated preference pairs across 8 creative writing genres, designed to evaluate subjective writing preferences beyond objective correctness.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark for subjective writing preference evaluation that has limited but growing use in work on preference modeling and creative writing assessment.
notes: Highlights challenges in modeling subjective preferences and shows that generative reward models with reasoning chains outperform sequence-based reward models.
